configs.name: 旧入门 · 75%随机+25%一手启发式

protocol.baseline: Exact pre-model browser 75% legal-random/25% top-three one-ply heuristic; seed=(ply+1)*7919; no book
protocol.selection: User-approved sampling exclusively from trained low-Elo policy softmax(logits/T); no uniform mixture or search. Candidate PRNG mixes board and pair seed; same profile and openings under paired colors.
protocol.limits: Paired-color confirmation games; see plannedGames; internal Elo is not official; no human win-rate or statistical significance claim
